name: Exploding Kittens

setup.text: Take the 4 Exploding Kittens out of the deck and set them aside.
Take out the 6 Defuses and deal 1 to each player.
Shuffle spare Defuses back into the deck and remove any others from the game.

by_count.2: Shuffle 2 back in; remove the other 2.
by_count.3: Shuffle 2 back in; remove the other 1.

setup.text: Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards face down to each player. Everyone now holds 8 cards.
Put Exploding Kittens back into the deck: one fewer than the number of players. Remove the rest.
Shuffle the deck and put it face down as the draw pile, leaving room for a discard pile.
Pick someone to go first; play runs clockwise.

steps: Play as many cards as you like, one at a time, following each card's text. Or play none.
End your turn by drawing the top card of the draw pile.
If you draw an Exploding Kitten, show it. Play a Defuse or you are out.

end: Players explode one by one. The last player left wins.

scoring.text: There is no scoring: the last player who has not exploded wins.

missed.text: After a Defuse, put the Exploding Kitten back anywhere in the draw pile, in secret, without reordering the other cards.
An Attack ends your turn without drawing and makes the next player take 2 turns. Attacks stack: an attacked player who plays an Attack passes on their remaining turns plus 2.
A Nope can be played at any time, even out of turn, and can be played on another Nope.
There is no hand limit. If you run out of cards you simply draw at the end of your next turn.
Faster variant: before inserting the Kittens, remove about a third of the deck at random.
